// The certificate profile hash is set by issuePrecertificateInner, which
	// validates that the CA is capable of issuing for the requested profile.
func (ca *certificateAuthorityImpl) issuePrecertificateInner(ctx context.Context, issueReq *capb.IssueCertificateRequest, serialBigInt *big.Int, validity validity) ([]byte, [32]byte, error) {
return nil, [32]byte{}, fmt.Errorf("the CA is not capable of using a profile named %s", issueReq.CertProfileName)
return nil, [32]byte{}, berrors.InternalServerError("no issuer found for public key algorithm %s", csr.PublicKeyAlgorithm)
return nil, [32]byte{}, berrors.InternalServerError("no issuer found for IssuerNameID %d", issueReq.IssuerNameID)
return nil, [32]byte{}, fmt.Errorf("computing subject key ID: %w", err)

545: 	// The certificate profile hash is checked here instead of the name because
546: 	// the hash is over the entire contents of a *ProfileConfig which includes
547: 	// the name giving more assurance that the certificate profile has remained
548: 	// unchanged during the roundtrip from a CA, to the RA, then back to a CA.
549: 	lintCertBytes, issuanceToken, err := issuer.Prepare(ca.certProfiles.profileByHash[profileHashBytes], req)
550: 	//certProfileCountLabels := prometheus.Labels{"purpose": string(precertType), "profile": issueReq.CertProfileName, "hash": hex.EncodeToString(profileHashBytes[:])}
551: 	if err != nil {
552: 		ca.log.AuditErrf("Preparing precert failed: serial=[%s] regID=[%d] names=[%s] certProfileName=[%s] certProfileHash=[%s] err=[%v]",
553: 			serialHex, issueReq.RegistrationID, strings.Join(csr.DNSNames, ", "), issueReq.CertProfileName, hex.EncodeToString(profileHashBytes[:]), err)
554: 		if errors.Is(err, linter.ErrLinting) {
555: 			ca.lintErrorCount.Inc()
556: 		}
557: 		return nil, nil, berrors.InternalServerError("failed to prepare precertificate signing: %s", err)
558: 	}
559: 
560: 	_, err = ca.sa.AddPrecertificate(context.Background(), &sapb.AddCertificateRequest{
561: 		Der:          lintCertBytes,
562: 		RegID:        issueReq.RegistrationID,
563: 		Issued:       timestamppb.New(ca.clk.Now()),
564: 		IssuerNameID: int64(issuer.NameID()),
565: 		OcspNotReady: true,
566: 	})
567: 	if err != nil {
568: 		return nil, nil, err
569: 	}
570: 
571: 	certDER, err := issuer.Issue(issuanceToken)
572: 	if err != nil {
573: 		ca.noteSignError(err)
574: 		ca.log.AuditErrf("Signing precert failed: serial=[%s] regID=[%d] names=[%s] certProfileName=[%s] certProfileHash=[%s] err=[%v]",
575: 			serialHex, issueReq.RegistrationID, strings.Join(csr.DNSNames, ", "), issueReq.CertProfileName, hex.EncodeToString(profileHashBytes[:]), err)
576: 		return nil, nil, berrors.InternalServerError("failed to sign precertificate: %s", err)
577: 	}
578: 
579: 	ca.signatureCount.With(prometheus.Labels{"purpose": string(precertType), "issuer": issuer.Name()}).Inc()
580: 	ca.log.AuditInfof("Signing precert success: serial=[%s] regID=[%d] names=[%s] precertificate=[%s] certProfileName=[%s] certProfileHash=[%s]",
581: 		serialHex, issueReq.RegistrationID, strings.Join(csr.DNSNames, ", "), hex.EncodeToString(certDER), issueReq.CertProfileName, hex.EncodeToString(profileHashBytes[:]))
582: 
583: 	return certDER, issuer, nil
584: }
